mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunk_bge_m3 (kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{docId} AS uuid), #{content}, #{metadata}, #{embedding}::vector, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.update:
UPDATE chunk_bge_m3
kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid),
doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid),
content = #{content},
metadata = #{metadata},
embedding = #{embedding}::vector,
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) ORDER BY embedding <-> #{vectorLiteral}::vector LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at, ts_rank_cd(content_tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query})) AS bm25_score FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) AND content_tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) ORDER BY bm25_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE chunk_bge_m3 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS content_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(content, ''))) STORED
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunk_content_tsv ON chunk_bge_m3 USING gin(content_tsv)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunk_embedding_hnsw ON chunk_bge_m3 USING hnsw (embedding vector_l2_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64)
